instruction: Start playing a playlist on Spotify that has enough songs for my workout today. I do not want to have to change the playlist in the middle of my workout. The workout plan is in Simple Note.
notes: Plan: show_profile gives the login email, show_account_passwords the passwords; simple_note login + search_notes('workout') + show_note retrieves the workout plan, whose per-weekday duration is parsed using today's weekday from phone.get_current_date_and_time (2023-05-23 is a Tuesday), modeled by the nullary (date-known) precondition on show_note. On Spotify, show_playlist_library lists playlists with their song_ids; show_song (no token needed) is called per song to sum durations, modeled with a single representative song object and a representative playlist object long-enough-playlist defined by the static fact (long-enough-for playlist duration). play_music with playlist_id replaces the queue with that playlist and starts playing, asserting (workout-playlist-playing), the only goal condition besides (task-completed). Loop over playlists/songs is collapsed to one representative object each; the agent repeats show_song/pagination at runtime as needed. complete_task takes no answer since the task is not a question.
